dataset: Leaderboard competition design — rewards for top-performing strategies
note: Design specification for the leaderboard that rewards top-performing strategies. All scoring is luck-adjusted and risk-controlled; raw profit alone never earns rewards. Numeric reward tiers are proposals pending the owner's decision (see Questions Q07 and Suggestions S07).

scoring.description: Primary skill metric: difference between the price taken and the closing price, measured per bet. Rewards price-finding skill independent of outcome variance.
Hit probability minus break-even probability at the taken price; the expected edge per bet.
Return measured against volatility and drawdown, so strategies are not rewarded for taking excessive risk.
Signal quality measured with luck-adjusted efficiency inputs (INT/drop/fumble luck stripped), used for strategy-level ranking.

rules.description: A strategy appears on the leaderboard only after passing all applicable validation gates (VG01-VG07). Gates are a prerequisite, not a ranking factor.
Strategies must have a minimum number of scored bets in the period before ranking; strategies below the minimum are shown but not ranked or rewarded.
Rankings are computed over walk-forward periods using only data available at the time of each bet; no look-ahead.
A strategy that fails a validation gate at any refresh point is demoted (suspended from rewards) until it passes a fresh walk-forward validation.
A strategy's logic is frozen for the scoring period; any change resets its walk-forward clock and forfeits the current period's rewards.

rewards.description: Highest luck-adjusted composite score for the period (proposal: reward as determined by the owner).
Second-highest luck-adjusted composite score for the period (proposal: reward as determined by the owner).
All strategies that pass gates and meet the minimum-bet requirement in the period, listed in ranked order (proposal: recognition, no monetary reward).
